t: Titan 600W electric jigsaw provides efficient cutting for various materials. Ideal for joiners and general builders needing precise cuts in wood, MDF, chipboard, plastic, and metal. Features 3-stage pendulum action and variable 6-speed control, ranging from 1200 to 3000rpm, to ensure optimal performance across different tasks. Tool-free blade changes simplify operation, while a robust all-metal gearbox and metal base offer durability. A lock-on trigger switch allows continuous use, and the soft-grip handle further enhances user comfort. Equipped with a dust vacuum facility to help maintain a clear workspace. Supplied with parallel guide, hex key, wood blade, and metal blade.
